feedback:
Approved for this race. The candidate is a single-variable test of kd. It restores the iteration-4 configuration (sensor row y = 0.05 m, wide span x = -0.07 to 0.07 m, base_speed 1.1, kp 2.0, ki 0.4, line_loss last_direction) and raises kd from 0.15 to 0.30. Iteration 5 rejected y = 0.02: slalom progress fell from 0.105 to 0.035 and no track improved, so reverting y is correct. Iterations 0 to 5 have pinned max_error at 0.061 to 0.063 across changes to kp, kd (0.05 to 0.15), ki, sensor_size, span, speed and y. kd has never been raised above 0.15, so this is the one untested lever in the feedback loop. The candidate is valid and not obviously broken, and the best raced score (iteration 1, 38.61) sets a bar this candidate does not need to clear to be useful as a test. Another revision round would cost two action runs without any new evidence to justify a different value. Expected effect: max_error may fall toward 0.06 on s-bend and slalom, but this is not yet shown. Steering oscillation is the main risk, since the derivative term acts on the per-second change in signal and noise is amplified at higher kd (steering_oscillation has ranged 0.064 to 0.148 so far).

What to change after the race, depending on what it shows:
- If max_error falls below 0.06 on s-bend or slalom and progress rises above the iteration-4 values (0.040 s-bend, 0.105 slalom), keep kd near 0.30 and step base_speed up (1.25, then 1.4) while checking that max_error stays under 0.06.
- If max_error stays near 0.061 at kd 0.30 with steering_oscillation no higher than about 0.10, the feedback loop is not the cause. Test line_loss = search_right or search_left, which no iteration has tried, and keep kd at 0.30.
- If steering_oscillation rises well above the 0.064 to 0.148 range without a max_error drop, return kd to 0.15 and do not raise it further.
requested_changes: Keep geometry.sensor_positions at y = 0.05 m with x = -0.07, -0.035, 0, 0.035, 0.07 m (iteration 5 showed y = 0.02 cut slalom progress from 0.105 to 0.035 and improved no track).

If max_error stays near 0.061 at kd = 0.30 (iterations 0 to 5 pinned it at 0.061 to 0.063 across every gain, span, speed and y change), set controller.line_loss = search_right or search_left in place of last_direction, which no iteration has tested.
If steering_oscillation rises well above the 0.064 to 0.148 range in iterations 0 to 5 without a max_error drop, return controller.kd to 0.15 with the other values unchanged.
